recommendation: Coordinate medication access for heart failure patients
implementation_steps: Coordinate medication access and manage refills to ensure continuous therapy
Monitor adherence through refill history analysis
Identify patients who miss refills and alert pharmacists
Help patients navigate insurance coverage and prior authorization requirements
Connect eligible patients to medication assistance programs
evidence_summary: Pharmacy technician interventions supporting medication access have been shown to improve medication adherence and continuity of therapy for patients with heart failure, particularly when integrated into comprehensive pharmacy-based heart failure management programs.
citation: Optimal Effectiveness of Heart Failure Management
